# Pratyay Docs

> Documentation for open-source developer tools by Pratyay Mustafi: setup guides,
> configuration recipes, and technical reference for Ensor, Dynamic UPI QR, Drawy,
> and Newsy. Built with Astro Starlight; all pages are Markdown and open source at
> https://github.com/Pratyay360/pratyay360.github.io

## Core pages

- [Introduction](https://pratyay360.github.io/): What this documentation site covers.
- [Getting Started](https://pratyay360.github.io/getting-started/): Quick navigation to every project guide.

## Guides

- [Dynamic UPI QR Generator](https://pratyay360.github.io/guides/upiqrcode/getting-started/): Client-side, WASM-powered UPI QR code generator and deep link generator.
- [UPI QR & Intent Format](https://pratyay360.github.io/guides/upiqrcode/upi-format/): UPI QR and intent format specification.
- [Ensor Secrets Redaction](https://pratyay360.github.io/guides/ensor/): Go CLI for scanning a codebase for hardcoded secrets and redacting them.
- [Drawy](https://pratyay360.github.io/guides/drawy/): Self-hostable, Excalidraw-based collaborative whiteboard (web edition).
- [DrawyParty](https://pratyay360.github.io/guides/drawy-party/): Collaborative whiteboard on Cloudflare PartyKit.
- [DrawX](https://pratyay360.github.io/guides/drawx/): Offline desktop whiteboard for Linux, macOS, and Windows.

## Optional

- [Privacy](https://pratyay360.github.io/privacy/): Site privacy policy.
